claims.text: UPI Lite is an on-device wallet functionality designed for small value digital payments that processes transactions in near offline or complete offline mode without requiring a UPI PIN.
It allows users to allocate funds from their bank account to the UPI Lite balance, which resides on the device and is held in an escrow account at the user's bank.
The per-transaction limit for UPI Lite was enhanced to ₹500, while the maximum balance allowed in a UPI Lite account remains ₹2000.
UPI Lite transactions are processed without AFA (App authentication) or UPI PIN by default, though app passcode or biometric authentication is recommended unless disabled by the user.
Users can enable, disable, and top up UPI Lite at any time, with funds transferring between the UPI Lite balance and the main bank account in real-time.
The UPI Lite balance is non-interest bearing.
